summary: Completed frontend-only validation of the SunoDistro AI landing page at https://future-music-os.preview.emergentagent.com. All 16 spec requirements pass: page loads cleanly, navbar (brand + 5 nav links + Log in + Get Started CTA), Hero (Create/Sing/Distribute headline + 2 CTAs + particle canvas + sunset orb), AI Music Generator (7 genre cards interactive, prompt/mood/tempo work), Lyrics typewriter section, AI Studio image with overlay cards, Distribution world-map SVG (15 SVGs incl. arcs/dots) + release timeline + 10 platform icon cards, 12 feature cards, Dashboard preview (412,890 listeners and $8,412.20 royalties tiles), 3 pricing plans (Artist/Label/Ultimate $20/$50/$55) with Ultimate highlighted via sun-border + 'MOST POWERFUL' badge, 3 testimonials with 5 stars, final CTA, footer with wordmark and copyright. All CTA hrefs exactly match spec. No horizontal scroll at 1920x1080 or 390x844. No console errors / pageerror events.
critical_code_review_comments: Landing.jsx is ~1493 lines — a single very large file. Recommend splitting into per-section components under /app/frontend/src/components/landing/ (Hero.jsx, Navbar.jsx, MusicGenerator.jsx, etc.) for maintainability. Non-blocking.
Footer 'Support/Terms/Privacy/Contact' and social icons use href='#' placeholders — acceptable for a static landing page but worth wiring up if these go to production.
ParticleCanvas attaches a window-level mousemove listener; fine for landing page but could be passive: true for slight perf improvement.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static frontend landing page only. All sections and CTA hrefs validated. External CTA URLs (release.sunodistro.com, ai.sunodistro.com) were verified by href attribute only — not navigated. data-testid coverage is complete on all interactive/key elements.
